note: Central war-score catalogue. Single source of truth: the TypeScript wrapper (src/audio/musicGenerationDefinitions.ts) types this file for the game, and scripts/generate-elevenlabs-audio.mjs reads the same file to drive generation. Editing it here updates both sides, so prompts and file names can never drift apart.

motifs.humanity: Humanity and the Ark: a simple rising four-note figure, warm strings carrying it, wide brass answering underneath. Fragile, stubborn, hopeful. Stated plainly in return-to-origin, fully in final-orbit-last-stand, quietly in ark-no-longer-alone.
motifs.pleyadian: The Pleyadians: open fifths and fourths, crystalline bell-like textures, soft analogue pads, a distant wordless airy choir. Ancient knowledge, never magical. Enters in final-orbit-allies and colours atlas-breach.
motifs.coalition: The Coalition of Silence: deep sub-bass, tense minor-second and tritone intervals, strict mechanical pulse, dark metallic textures, no heroism and no melody. Owns war-ambient, silence-rupture and the low end of every combat cue.

tracks.title: La amenaza distante
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words, no vocals except a very distant wordless texture. Slow tempo around 60 BPM. Low sustained synthesizer drones, deep sub bass, distant mechanical pulses on an irregular grid, dark sustained strings, minimal percussion, occasional metallic resonance. Atmosphere of being quietly watched by something non-human. Restrained dynamics, no climax, no melody, no recognizable theme. Clean spacious mix with wide stereo and plenty of headroom for dialogue. Steady even ending suitable for seamless looping and crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: Presencia de la Coalición, vigilancia y calma inquietante entre combates.

tracks.title: Alerta de combate
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Medium tempo around 96 BPM. Progressive tension: contained hybrid percussion, tight electronic pulses, rhythmic ostinato strings, occasional low brass swells, cold synthesizer textures. Builds steadily without ever reaching a full battle climax. No melody, no recognizable theme, no triumph. Clean dynamic mix leaving room for alarms and dialogue. Open unresolved ending suitable for crossfade into combat music.
tracks.narrativeUse: Sensores activos, firmas acercándose y preparación defensiva.

tracks.title: Primer fuego
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction battle score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Opens with a 15 to 20 second atmospheric introduction of low drones and distant metallic pulses, then rising tension. Tempo around 110 BPM. Cinematic percussion with taiko-like low hits, fast agitated string ostinato, cold analogue synthesizer layers, restrained brass. Heroism is present but contained and uncertain, never triumphant. No melody quotation, no recognizable theme. Ends without full resolution, tension still held. Clean wide mix with headroom for weapons and dialogue. Ending suitable for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M18: el primer enfrentamiento armado real en Aurora.

tracks.title: Intercepción
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction combat score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Fast tempo around 140 BPM with a strong sense of speed and motion. Driving hybrid percussion, precise electronic pulses, relentless string ostinato, spacious synthesizer pads, brass stabs on the important accents. Intense and controlled, cinematic rather than arcade, no cheap drops and no distorted bass drops. No melody, no recognizable theme. Consistent energy throughout so it can loop as a combat bed. Clean punchy mix with room for weapon effects. Even ending suitable for seamless looping.
tracks.narrativeUse: Combate de nave contra drones e interceptores.

tracks.title: Nereida bajo ataque
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Dark and desperate, defending a familiar place that is being taken apart. Tempo around 100 BPM. Heavy cinematic percussion, low brass clusters, urgent strings, and an emotional restrained motif suggesting ancient technology under threat, played on warm strings against cold metallic resonance. Mixture of old alien machinery and immediate danger. No triumph, no melody quotation, no recognizable theme. Clean mix with headroom for alarms and dialogue. Ending open for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M19: defensa de Base Nereida contra la incursión coordinada.

tracks.title: Brecha Atlas
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score of extreme tension, no lyrics, no spoken words. Tempo unstable around 90 BPM with irregular pulses. Unstable low bass, dissonant strings, musical interference textures like corrupted signal and filtered static used musically, fractured percussion, and a very subtle processed wordless choir far back in the mix. Sense of an ancient machine being broken into. No melody, no recognizable theme, no resolution. Clean controlled mix, never harsh or painful. Ending that lifts slightly so it can crossfade into a counterattack cue.

tracks.title: Batalla por el Arca
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction battle score of large orbital scale, no lyrics, no spoken words. Heroic but dark. Structure in five parts: an atmospheric introduction of drones and distant pulses, a rising tension section, a full combat section, a climax, and an open unresolved exit. Tempo around 120 BPM in the combat sections. Full cinematic percussion, wide brass, fast strings, spacious synthesizers, and a controlled wordless choir used sparingly. Includes a simple rising four-note figure on warm strings and answering brass as the recurring human motif. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean wide dynamic mix with headroom for combat effects and dialogue. Ending open for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M20 y enfrentamientos posteriores alrededor del Arca.

tracks.title: La ruptura del Silencio
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Enormous, slow, oppressive and ceremonial. Very slow tempo around 50 BPM with deliberate silences between events. Distant brass held very long, extremely deep sub bass, slow mechanical pulses like an immense machine turning over, sparse dark strings, cold metallic resonance. Sense of a scale that cannot be comprehended, and of something arriving rather than attacking. This is not battle music. No melody, no recognizable theme, no percussion groove. Clean mix with enormous low end and wide space. Ending that fades into near silence for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M21: aparición de la nave capital y el ultimátum.

tracks.title: Frentes rotos
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score of strategic tension, no lyrics, no spoken words. Tempo around 108 BPM with a persistent driving pulse that never rests. Layered construction: a simple rhythmic core that gradually adds hybrid percussion, low strings, electronic sequences and restrained brass, suggesting three separate fronts under pressure at once. Deliberately leaves midrange space so dialogue, alarms and effects stay audible; avoid constant orchestral saturation. No melody, no recognizable theme, no climax resolution. Clean disciplined mix. Ending open for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M22: tres frentes simultáneos bajo presión sostenida.

tracks.title: Contraofensiva
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score of momentum and determination, no lyrics, no spoken words. Tempo around 128 BPM. Ascending cinematic percussion, heroic wide brass, rhythmic driving strings, bright but serious synthesizer layers. Carries a stronger statement of a simple rising four-note human motif on strings and brass. The feeling is hope that has been earned through cost, not easy triumphalism, so keep a dark undertone in the low end. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean powerful mix with headroom for effects. Ending strong but open for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M23: la humanidad deja de retroceder y contraataca.

tracks.title: Regreso al origen
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Emotional, nostalgic and contemplative, preparing for a final battle. First half atmospheric and intimate around 66 BPM: solo warm strings, sparse piano-like tones, soft pads, long silences, stating a simple rising four-note human motif quietly and unadorned. Second half grows progressively epic with cinematic percussion, wide brass and full strings restating the same motif. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean dynamic mix with a very wide quiet-to-loud range. Ending open for crossfade into a battle cue.
tracks.narrativeUse: M24: regreso al escenario inicial del juego antes de la batalla final.

tracks.title: Última órbita — Introducción
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Slow tempo around 62 BPM. Space and silence: sustained low pads, very distant metallic resonance, sparse warm strings stating a simple rising four-note human motif in an intimate unadorned form, with deliberate gaps of near silence. Tension held before an enormous battle, no percussion groove. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean spacious mix. Ending that rises slightly and stays unresolved, suitable for a clean crossfade into a full assault cue.
tracks.narrativeUse: M25 sección 1: regreso al lugar inicial y tensión previa.

tracks.title: Última órbita — Asalto
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction battle score at maximum orbital scale, no lyrics, no spoken words. Fast tempo around 132 BPM. Full cinematic percussion, fast aggressive strings, wide powerful brass, dense spacious synthesizers and a controlled wordless choir. Relentless sense of a massive battle in orbit. No melody quotation, no recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean powerful mix that still leaves headroom for weapons and dialogue, never over-compressed. Consistent high energy from start to end so it can loop, with an even ending suitable for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M25 sección 2: el asalto orbital pleno.

tracks.title: Última órbita — Escudo roto
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words. Begins with an abrupt drop in intensity, as if the music itself lost power. Slow unstable tempo around 76 BPM. Deep bass, emergency pulses on an irregular grid, filtered technical textures, thin exposed strings, sparse percussion hits with long gaps. Sense of a protective shield collapsing and systems failing. No melody, no recognizable theme, no heroism. Clean controlled mix with strong low end and a lot of empty space for alarms. Ending open for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M25 sección 3: caída del escudo y tensión técnica.

tracks.title: Última órbita — Aliados
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score of harmonic expansion and arrival, no lyrics, no spoken words except a distant wordless airy choir. Tempo around 112 BPM building. Opens narrow and grows wide: warm strings and brass carrying a simple rising four-note human motif, joined progressively by open fifths, crystalline bell-like textures and soft analogue pads representing an ancient benevolent civilisation. The two colours combine rather than compete. Hopeful, serious, earned. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean expansive mix. Ending strong and open for crossfade.
tracks.narrativeUse: M25 sección 4: llegada de Aurora, Nereida y apoyo Pleyadiano.

tracks.title: Última órbita — Resistencia final
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score at maximum intensity, no lyrics, no spoken words, with a full controlled wordless choir. Tempo around 126 BPM. Complete cinematic percussion, full brass, driving strings and dense synthesizers, stating a simple rising four-note human motif in its fullest and most complete form. Feeling of sacrifice and hope at once, a decisive final defence beside a great ship. Powerful but never chaotic, and never over-compressed. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean wide mix with real dynamic range. Ending open for crossfade into a quiet resolution.
tracks.narrativeUse: M25 sección 5: la batalla definitiva junto al Arca.

tracks.title: Última órbita — Resolución
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score of emotional resolution, no lyrics, no spoken words. Percussion falls away progressively until it is gone. Very slow tempo around 56 BPM. Long sustained notes on warm strings, soft brass held far back, gentle pads, and real silence used as an element. A quiet incomplete statement of a simple rising four-note human motif, left unresolved and then allowed to settle. Grief and relief together. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean intimate mix with wide space. Long gentle fade suitable for crossfade or for ending cleanly.
tracks.narrativeUse: M25 sección 6: descenso emocional tras la batalla.

tracks.title: El Arca ya no está sola
tracks.prompt: Instrumental cinematic science-fiction score, no lyrics, no spoken words, with a very soft distant wordless choir. Emotive, serene, hopeful and wide. Slow tempo around 64 BPM. Warm strings carrying a calm complete version of a simple rising four-note human motif, gentle brass underneath, soft pads and subtle crystalline textures. Room for memory of those who did not arrive: keep a melancholy undertone and avoid any excessive triumph. No recognizable theme from any existing work. Clean warm mix with wide stereo and generous headroom. Long gentle ending suitable for looping under an epilogue or fading out.
